name: Billit

sandbox.notes: Free self-serve registration at my.sandbox.billit.be/Account/Register (company name, e-mail, password), 'no credit card required', '100% commitment-free' (verified directly on the vendor's own site, 2026-09-23).

provenance.sourceText: backend/src/modules/documents/transports/billit-transport.ts header: "Billit (billit.be), a Belgian Peppol access point that is also registered by the DGFiP as a French 'plateforme agreee'".

notes: Deposits Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 UBL, never the French PA-native flow (billit-transport.ts's own header: 'NO FRENCH plateforme agreee FLOW. Billit's PA routing is a different set of endpoints... this transport speaks Peppol only'). The credential shape has its own 'baseUrl' field (sandbox vs production host differ), but that is a routine environment split for this ONE dedicated 'billit' transport, not multi-operator disambiguation -- see this catalogue's own schema.ts header for why 'baseUrl' on an OperatorFact is reserved for the 'pdp' multi-operator case. Known limit on the path to production (2026-09-24): the API key this transport authenticates with is, in Billit's own words, 'only allowed for non-commercial integrations' -- a commercial production integration needs OAuth credentials and an approval step from Billit support.
